'''Stangg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] member of [[The Shroud's syndicate]]. During the [[Galactic War]], a conflict fought between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed at one of [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s hidden bases, where he was confronted and killed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stangg appears as a boss in the Shroud's storyline, appearing either on [[Quesh]] if playing as a Republic character, or on Dromund Kaas if playing as an Imperial character.<ref name="TOR" />
